home.title: BetInsight
home.description: Transparent AI forecasts for sports events.
home.disclaimer: 18+. Information only. This is not a call to place bets.

storage.file: Neon is not connected. Settings and logs are stored locally in data/admin-state.json and are not used in production.

login.title: Administrator sign-in
login.description: The panel is private. API keys stay on the server.
login.invalid_credentials: The email or password is wrong.
login.not_configured: ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD and AUTH_SECRET are not set.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Leagues, credit spend and integration status.
overview.statsDescription: Public metrics and the tracks' virtual statistics start again from the reset. Predictions stay in the database.
overview.epochAll: The series includes every record so far.
overview.resetConfirm: Metrics on the site, in the bot and in the admin will start from zero. Published predictions are kept and do not join the new series.
overview.creditsFallback: No API header yet, so the balance comes from the ledger
overview.ledgerNote: Logged this month: {ledger}. The API header counts {header} as spent.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Leagues, markets, region, value thresholds and both LLM tracks. Totals ranges are separate for football, the Euroleague, the NBA and tennis.
settings.leaguesDescription: Clear a league to keep it out of odds requests.
settings.marketsDescription: An /odds request costs the number of markets times the number of regions.
settings.regionHint: eu by default, because Pinnacle is quoted there.
settings.thresholdsDescription: A candidate passes when EV is above the threshold. An outcome with EV from 0 up to the threshold is kept as a near miss and stays out of the public stats. The threshold can be lowered to 0%.
settings.modelDescription: The Value-track model. Changing the identifier does not require a code change. Free models and latest aliases cannot be saved.
settings.reserveHint: Odds requests stop when they would leave less than the reserve.
settings.testRunsHint: At most one run every 5 minutes. The day resets at 00:00 UTC.
settings.webSearch: Web search for final candidates only
settings.webSearchLimitHint: The day resets at 00:00 UTC. Search runs for Value candidates and for the AI-pick researcher.
settings.aiPickDescription: Three models from different providers vote independently. A forecast is kept only when they agree. When the monthly budget is spent, this track pauses and Value keeps running.
settings.researchModelHint: It does not vote. Leave empty to let the first voting model search.
settings.toleranceHint: The average probability must be at least 1 / price minus this tolerance.
settings.aiPickMinEvHint: A negative value only drops outcomes that are clearly expensive. Default is −3.
settings.shortlistHint: At most this many events per day, ranked by EV.
settings.aiPickBudgetHint: Counts search and votes. Value checks are outside this limit.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: The Odds API credits and model cost. Test runs are included in the same ledger.
budget.creditsFallback: No API header yet, so the balance comes from the ledger
budget.ledgerNote: Logged this month: {ledger}. The API header counts {header} as spent.

tracks.title: Forecast tracks
tracks.description: Model votes, missed consensus and the virtual near-miss stats. None of this enters the public record.
tracks.paused: The AI-pick monthly budget is spent: new votes stop, and the Value track keeps running.
tracks.favoriteWarning: More than 90% of agreements matched the market favourite. The track is copying the market.
tracks.candidateDescription: Outcomes with EV above the threshold. These are not published forecasts yet.
tracks.emptyCandidates: No candidates yet. They appear after odds are fetched.
tracks.savedDescription: A forecast is stored before the match starts. The public site shows it in a later stage.
tracks.nearMissDescription: Outcomes with EV from zero up to the threshold. Results are not settled yet: this is selection, not ROI.
tracks.emptyNearMiss: No near misses yet. They appear after a test or a model run.
tracks.votesDescription: Events without agreement are kept together with every vote.

jobs.title: Job log
jobs.description: Only a failed job can be queued again. The message is published to QStash when the scheduler is configured.

settlement.title: Manual settlement
settlement.description: Only events missing from /scores, already started, with an unsettled pick. The comment is required and written to the audit log.

test.title: Chain check
test.description: Odds request, the mathematical model, the Value check and the AI-pick vote. Nothing is written to predictions, the public site or Telegram.
test.noLeagues: No leagues are enabled. Turn one on in settings.
test.mocked: Preview or mock mode: The Odds API is not called and no credits are spent.
test.noModelRows: There is nothing to score in these prices.
test.consensusYes: The models agreed. The forecast is not written to the predictions table.
test.consensusNo: There is no agreement. The event stays filtered by consensus.
test.matchesFavorite: The selection matches the market favourite.
test.notPublished: The test does not publish a forecast and does not change the stats.
test.value_cap: The Value check runs for at most three candidate events.
test.no_value_candidates: There are no Value candidates, so that model was not called.
test.ai_pick_disabled: The AI-pick track is turned off in settings.
test.ai_pick_budget: The AI-pick monthly budget is spent, so the vote was skipped.
test.ai_pick_cap: The test votes on one shortlisted event.
test.no_shortlist: No event reached the AI-pick shortlist.
test.web_search_limited: The daily web-search limit is used up, so later requests run without search.
test.missing_openrouter_key: The OpenRouter key is missing, so the LLM blocks were skipped.

errors.reserve: The request was stopped: it would leave less than the results reserve.
errors.insufficient: There are not enough credits for this request.
errors.odds_range: The lower price bound is above the upper bound.
errors.totals_range: The lower totals bound is above the upper bound.
errors.leagues: At least one league must stay enabled.
errors.free_model: A free model cannot be saved.
errors.ai_pick_providers: The vote needs three different models from three providers.
errors.ai_pick_alias: Use a concrete model id, without :free and without a latest alias.
errors.ai_pick_research: The search model has to be different from the voting models.
errors.ai_pick_range: The lower AI-pick price bound is above the upper bound.
errors.unknown_prompt: That prompt version is not in the repository.
errors.interval: The next test can run in 5 minutes.
errors.daily: The daily test-run limit is used up.
errors.missing_odds_key: The Odds API key is not set.
errors.odds_failed: The Odds API did not return a usable response.
errors.not_failed: Only a failed job can be restarted.
errors.scheduler_unconfigured: QStash is not configured, so the job was not queued.
errors.publish_failed: QStash did not accept the message.
errors.not_found: The forecast or event was not found.
errors.not_eligible: The event can still arrive from /scores.
errors.comment: The comment must be 10 to 500 characters.
